sentences.text: Brick is a 2005 American neo-noir mystery film written and directed by Rian Johnson in his directorial debut , starring Joseph Gordon-Levitt .	Rian Johnson	Rian Johnson	Joseph Gordon-Levitt	Joseph Gordon-Levitt	neo-noir	neo-noir	mystery	Mystery film
Brick was distributed by Focus Features , and opened in New York and Los Angeles on April 7 , 2006 .	Focus Features	Focus Features
The film 's narrative centers on a hardboiled detective story set in a Californian suburb .	hardboiled	hardboiled	detective story	detective fiction	suburb	suburb
Most of the main characters are high school students .
The film draws heavily in plot , characterization , and dialogue from hardboiled classics , especially those by Dashiell Hammett .	hardboiled	hardboiled	Dashiell Hammett	Dashiell Hammett
The title refers to a block of heroin , compressed roughly to the size and shape of a brick .	heroin	heroin
The film won the Special Jury Prize for Originality of Vision at the 2005 Sundance Film Festival , and received positive reviews from critics .	Sundance Film Festival	Sundance Film Festival
It has come to be regarded as a cult classic .	cult classic	cult classic
